entities.name: Konrad II. von Babenberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Conrad of Babenberg was a nobleman and prelate of the Holy Roman Empire. He was the bishop of Passau from 1148/1149 until 1164 and then archbishop of Salzburg and Primate until his death, although he lost control of Salzburg when he was placed under the imperial ban in 1166.
